name: Dragon Die
text: One of your three d6 is a different color. It decides degrees of success, tie-breaks, stunt points and some spell effects.

name: 1d3
text: Roll a d6 and halve it: 1-2 is 1, 3-4 is 2, 5-6 is 3.

name: Ability test
text: 3d6 + ability + focus (+2 if you have the focus). Only one focus can apply to a test. Compare the result with a Target Number (TN); equal or higher succeeds.

name: Target Number (TN)
text: The number a test result must reach. Routine 7, Easy 9, Average 11, Challenging 13, Hard 15, Formidable 17, Imposing 19, Nigh Impossible 21. An attack roll uses the target's Defense as its TN.

name: Focus
text: A specialty inside an ability, written Ability (Focus), e.g. Cunning (Arcane Lore). It gives +2 to a test it applies to (+3 when doubled). 'Focus required' means you fail automatically without it.

name: Opposed test
text: Both sides roll and the higher result wins. Ties go to the higher Dragon Die, then to the higher ability. With more than two sides the highest wins, with the same tie-breaks.

name: Advanced test
text: Repeated tests add up toward a success threshold (Easy 5, Average 10, Challenging 15, Hard 20, Formidable 25). The first side to reach it wins.

name: Degrees of success
text: Only when a test succeeds: read the Dragon Die. 1 is a narrow success, 6 or more is spectacular. From level 6 you may add the test's focus bonus to the Dragon Die.

name: Reaction test
text: Resisting something (a spell, a shove) is a test made on someone else's turn. It takes no time.

name: Stacking
text: Different effects add up. Several copies of the same talent, power or spell do not, unless the text says so.

name: Stunt points (SP)
text: Roll doubles on a successful attack, spell or certain tests and you get stunt points equal to the Dragon Die. Spend them at once; each stunt can be done once per round (Skirmish excepted).

name: Doubles
text: Two of your three dice showing the same number. On a successful roll that allows stunts, doubles give stunt points.

name: Spell stunt
text: A stunt bought with stunt points after a successful casting roll with doubles, such as Puissant Casting or Mighty Spell.

name: Round
text: 15 seconds of action time, four to the minute. Narrative time outside combat is loose.

name: Initiative
text: A Dexterity (Initiative) test at the start of a fight. The order stays fixed for the whole encounter; latecomers roll at the start of the round they arrive. Ties: higher Dragon Die, then higher ability.

name: Turn
text: One major action and one minor action, or two minor actions, in any order. Doing less is fine. Free actions do not count.

name: Major action
text: All-Out Attack, Charge, Defend, Heal, Melee Attack, Ranged Attack or Run. Casting and reloading can also be major actions.

name: Minor action
text: Activate, Aim, Guard Up, Move, Prepare, Press the Attack, Ready or Stand Firm. Casting and reloading can also be minor actions.

name: Free action
text: A trivial act such as speaking a few words. It does not use up your actions.

name: All-Out Attack
text: Major action: melee attack on an adjacent enemy. +1 damage on a hit, but -1 Defense until your next turn, hit or miss.

name: Charge
text: Major action: move up to half your Speed (round down), then make a melee attack with +1 to the attack roll.

name: Defend
text: Major action: +2 Defense until the start of your next turn.

name: Heal (action)
text: Major action: an adjacent ally, bandages needed. TN 11 Cunning (Healing). On a success the ally regains the Dragon Die + your Cunning in Health, and cannot benefit again until hurt again.

name: Melee Attack
text: Major action: attack an adjacent enemy. Anything within 2 yards counts as adjacent.

name: Ranged Attack
text: Major action: shoot or throw at a visible enemy within range.

name: Run
text: Major action: move up to double your Speed. Not possible while prone.

name: Activate
text: Minor action: start using a power or item, such as a fighting style or a potion.

name: Aim
text: Minor action: +1 to the attack roll of your next melee or ranged attack.

name: Guard Up
text: Minor action, before any major action this turn: +1 or +2 Defense until the end of the round, with the same penalty to all your tests for the rest of the round.

name: Move
text: Minor action: up to your Speed in yards. Going prone, standing up or mounting costs half your Speed (round down).

name: Prepare
text: Minor action: pick a major action to carry out as an interrupt before your next turn, then end your turn. Not possible after a major action.

name: Press the Attack
text: Minor action: if an enemy you struck this turn moves away, follow it up to your Speed right after its movement.

name: Ready
text: Minor action: draw or stow a weapon or an item.

name: Stand Firm
text: Minor action: until your next turn, enemies using Skirmish or Knock Prone on you must win Strength (Might) against your Strength (Might) or Dexterity (Acrobatics).

name: Attack roll
text: 3d6 + the ability of the weapon group + a matching focus + modifiers, against the target's Defense. Equal or higher is a hit.

name: Defense
text: 10 + Dexterity + shield bonus. It is the TN to hit you.

name: Damage
text: Weapon dice + Strength (bows add Perception instead) + modifiers - the target's Armor Rating. Never below 0; a hit can do no damage.

name: Armor Rating
text: Damage that armor soaks up from every hit. Penetrating damage ignores it.

name: Armor penalty
text: Heavier armor lowers your Speed, and also your Dexterity for Defense unless you have Armor Training.

name: Penetrating damage
text: Damage that ignores Armor Rating.

name: Speed
text: How many yards you move with a Move action. Depends on race and Dexterity, and is lowered by the armor penalty.

name: Prone
text: Lying down. Melee attacks against a prone target get +1. A prone character cannot Run and needs a Move action to stand.

name: Cover
text: Light cover gives the defender -2 to be hit by attacks (-3 for heavy cover).

name: Higher ground
text: An attacker on higher ground gets +1 to the attack roll.

name: Outnumbering
text: Melee attackers and allies who outnumber the defender 2:1 get +1 to attack, 3:1 get +2.

name: Unaware defender
text: An attack against a defender who does not know it is coming gets +3.

name: Mounted combat
text: Mounting is part of a Move action (half Speed). The mount's Speed is used afterward. Melee attacks from the saddle get +1 against foes on foot. Knock Prone against a rider: Dexterity (Riding) against TN 10 + attacker's Strength.

name: Health
text: Class base + Constitution + 1d6 at level 1, increased each level. At 0 a player character is dying.

name: Dying
text: A character at 0 Health dies at the start of their turn after 2 + Constitution rounds unless healed. They can talk but take no other actions. Health never goes below 0.

name: Pulling a killing blow
text: The attacker may leave the target unconscious at 1 Health instead. It wakes after 2d6 minutes.

name: Coup de grace
text: A major action against an adjacent dying or unconscious target: automatic kill. At range it needs an attack roll against Defense 10.

name: Breather
text: 5 minutes of rest, once per encounter (not if you ended the fight at 0 Health). Heals 5 + Constitution + level.

name: Restful sleep
text: 6 hours of sleep heal 10 + Constitution + level Health.

name: Mana points (MP)
text: The fuel for spells. 10 + Magic + 1d6 at level 1, more each level. The cost is paid when you take the casting action, whether or not the spell works.

name: Regaining mana
text: Each full hour of rest or meditation restores 1d6 + Magic MP. Eight hours of uninterrupted rest restore all of it.

name: School of magic
text: Every spell belongs to a school: Creation, Entropy, Primal or Spirit (Blood is a fifth school for Blood Mages). The casting roll uses the focus of the spell's school.

name: Casting roll
text: 3d6 + Magic + the focus of the spell's school. Meet or beat the spell's TN or it fizzles; the mana is still spent.

name: Spellpower
text: 10 + Magic + the school focus. Targets that get a resisting test roll against it.

name: Armor strain
text: Extra mana added to the cost of every spell while you wear armor: light leather 1, heavy leather 2, light mail 3, heavy mail 4, light plate 5, heavy plate 6.

name: Spell requirement
text: Some spells need another spell, a talent rank or a specialization before they can be learned.

name: Magical mishap
text: Only for spells that have a requirement: the casting roll fails and the Dragon Die shows 1. The caster tests Willpower (Self-Discipline) against the spell TN. Success: prone (or pay the spell's cost again to stay up). Failure: a mishap read from that test's Dragon Die.

name: Mana Drain
text: Mishap: lose mana equal to twice the spell's original cost.

name: Mana Burn
text: Mishap: lose Health equal to twice the spell's original cost.

name: Backlash
text: Mishap: you cannot cast for 1d6 rounds.

name: Misfire
text: Mishap: the effect hits an ally instead of an enemy, or is reversed. The GM decides the details.

name: Lost in the Fade
text: Mishap: helpless trance for 2d6 minutes, open to a coup de grace.

name: Harrowing (mishap)
text: Mishap: as Lost in the Fade, plus TN 13 Willpower (Faith or Self-Discipline) every 2 minutes or a demon possesses the caster.

name: Stacked spells
text: A target can be under one casting of a given spell at a time. Casting it again does nothing and does not extend the duration. Instant, permanent effects such as healing are exempt. Different spells add up.

name: Blood magic
text: A fifth school, only for characters with the Blood Mage specialization, cast in Blood Magic mode. Stigmatized almost everywhere outside Tevinter.

name: Tranquil
text: Mages cut off from the Fade. They cannot cast. Not a player option in the core book.

name: Ability
text: One of eight scores, -2 to 4 at the start: Communication, Constitution, Cunning, Dexterity, Magic, Perception, Strength, Willpower.

name: Background
text: Where your character comes from. It gives an ability bonus, a focus, languages and two results from a 2d6 table.

name: Class
text: Warrior, Rogue or Mage. It sets your health, your powers at each level, starting talents and weapon groups.

name: Talent
text: A special training with three degrees: Novice, Journeyman and Master. Most have requirements.

name: Specialization
text: An advanced path a class can take, usually from level 6. It has Novice, Journeyman and Master degrees.

name: Weapon group
text: A family of weapons that share an attack ability and focus (axes, bows, heavy blades...). Without the group you attack at -2 and do half damage.

name: Level and XP
text: Experience points rise as you play. Reaching the next threshold lets you level up: an ability advancement, a focus, a talent or similar, plus health and mana.

name: Ability advancement
text: Raising an ability at level-up. Even levels use the class's primary ability, odd levels the secondary. The cost is 1, 2 or 3 advancements depending on the rating.

name: Coins
text: 1 gold = 100 silver, 1 silver = 100 copper. The app stores copper and shows gold, silver and copper.
